extraction.Name: Hobart Bissonette Jr.
extraction.Refused/Protested: I did not want to take this patent as covering my allotment NO. 7309. I did not want to pay taxes on the land and at that time was not able to do so. I did not ask for this patent and the same was forced on me.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I sold the land to Philip Points for a little money and some horses
extraction.Buyer: Philip Points; price included a little money and some horses; exact cash amount not stated
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I did not want to pay taxes on the land and at that time was not able to do so; Mr. Points wanted me to pay a years taxes which I did, the taxes amounted to $18.00
extraction.NOTES: Received a letter from the Indian office stating he had a patent covering his allotment; did not know anything about land deals at the time; part of the price was horses; has three children depending on him for support. Document sworn in Dawes County, Nebraska, March 1929. | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
